summary.text: 2022年11月30日，OpenAI低调发布了一个名为ChatGPT的“研究预览版”聊天机器人。这个基于GPT-3.5模型微调的产品，利用了“人类反馈强化学习”（RLHF）技术，使其能够以惊人的流畅度、逻辑性和安全性与人类对话。它不仅仅是回答问题，还能写代码、写诗、通过法律考试。ChatGPT的发布瞬间引爆了互联网，仅用5天时间用户数就突破了100万（Instagram用了2.5个月），2个月突破1亿，成为历史上增长最快的消费级应用。它标志着生成式AI（AIGC）时代的正式到来，迫使Google发布“红色代码”警报，并引发了全球科技巨头的千模大战。
summary.text_en: On November 30, 2022, OpenAI quietly released a 'research preview' chatbot named ChatGPT. Based on the GPT-3.5 model and fine-tuned using 'Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback' (RLHF), it could converse with humans with astonishing fluency, logic, and safety. It didn't just answer questions; it wrote code, composed poetry, and passed bar exams. ChatGPT's release instantly ignited the internet, reaching 1 million users in just 5 days (Instagram took 2.5 months) and 100 million in 2 months, becoming the fastest-growing consumer app in history. It marked the official arrival of the Generative AI (AIGC) era, forcing Google to declare a 'Code Red' and triggering a global 'War of a Thousand Models' among tech giants.
key_points: 基于GPT-3.5架构，核心突破是RLHF (人类反馈强化学习)
打破了图灵测试的心理防线，让公众第一次觉得AI“像人”
5天100万用户，2个月1亿用户，创历史纪录
引发了微软对OpenAI的百亿美元投资
导致教育、编程、写作等行业的范式转移
key_points_en: Based on GPT-3.5, with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) as the core breakthrough
Breached the psychological barrier of the Turing Test, making the public feel AI was 'human-like' for the first time
1 million users in 5 days, 100 million in 2 months, setting historical records
Triggered a multi-billion dollar investment from Microsoft
Caused a paradigm shift in industries like education, coding, and writing

story.text: ChatGPT的发布原本只是OpenAI的一个“权宜之计”。当时，OpenAI内部正在全力研发GPT-4，但为了收集更多人类反馈数据，管理层决定先把GPT-3.5包装成聊天界面发布出来。不仅是Sam Altman，就连首席科学家Ilya Sutskever都对它没抱太大期望，甚至担心人们会觉得它无聊。然而，简单的对话框界面（Chat UI）彻底改变了用户与AI的交互方式。一夜之间，Twitter（X）上充斥着人们展示ChatGPT写代码、写情书的截图。这种病毒式的传播让OpenAI的服务器在接下来的几个月里频繁崩溃。它不仅震惊了大众，也让Google高层彻夜难眠——因为这直接威胁到了搜索引擎的商业模式。
story.text_en: The release of ChatGPT was originally just a 'stopgap measure' for OpenAI. At the time, the team was fully focused on developing GPT-4, but to gather more human feedback data, management decided to wrap GPT-3.5 in a chat interface and ship it. Neither Sam Altman nor Chief Scientist Ilya Sutskever had high expectations, even fearing people would find it boring. However, the simple Chat UI completely revolutionized how users interacted with AI. Overnight, Twitter (X) was flooded with screenshots of ChatGPT writing code and love letters. This viral spread caused OpenAI's servers to crash frequently for months. It shocked not just the public but also kept Google executives awake at night—as it posed a direct threat to the search engine business model.

fun_facts.text: 在ChatGPT发布前两周，Sam Altman还在犹豫要不要发，因为团队觉得它还有很多幻觉问题（一本正经胡说八道）。最终他们决定以“研究预览”的名义发布，没想到却成为了产品史上的奇迹。
fun_facts.text_en: Two weeks before launch, Sam Altman was still hesitating whether to ship it, as the team felt it had too many hallucination issues (confidently speaking nonsense). They finally decided to release it as a 'research preview', unexpectedly creating a product miracle.

fun_facts.text: ChatGPT的运行成本极高。据估计，在刚发布时，每一次对话的电费和算力成本约为几美分，这让OpenAI每天要烧掉几十万美元来维持免费服务。
fun_facts.text_en: Running ChatGPT is incredibly expensive. It was estimated that at launch, each conversation cost a few cents in electricity and compute, forcing OpenAI to burn hundreds of thousands of dollars daily to keep the free service running.

simple_explanation.text:
以前的AI（如Siri）像是一个关键词检索器，你问“天气”，它给你报天气。
ChatGPT像是一个读过互联网上所有书的大学生。你问它问题，它是根据它脑子里的知识，一个字一个字地“猜”下一个字该说什么。
加上RLHF技术，它还学会了看人脸色，知道什么样的回答是有礼貌、有帮助的。
simple_explanation.text_en:
Previous AI (like Siri) was like a keyword retriever; you ask 'weather', it reports weather.
ChatGPT is like a college student who has read every book on the internet. When you ask a question, it 'guesses' the next word one by one based on the knowledge in its brain.
With RLHF technology, it also learned to 'read the room', knowing what kind of answers are polite and helpful.

applications.title: Copilot (编程助手)
applications.text: ChatGPT让每个程序员都拥有了一个结对编程伙伴，能自动写出复杂的函数，甚至解释遗留代码。
applications.text_en: ChatGPT gave every programmer a pair-programming partner, capable of automatically writing complex functions and even explaining legacy code.

applications.title: 教育变革
applications.text: 学生用它写论文，老师用它出考题。ChatGPT彻底打破了传统的家庭作业模式，迫使教育界重新思考“评估”的定义。
applications.text_en: Students use it to write essays, teachers use it to create exams. ChatGPT completely broke the traditional homework model, forcing the education sector to rethink the definition of 'assessment'.

impact.text: ChatGPT是人工智能历史的分水岭。在它之前，AI是后台的算法（推荐系统、人脸识别）；在它之后，AI变成了前台的生产力工具。它引发了对于通用人工智能（AGI）的广泛讨论，也带来了关于AI安全、版权、就业替代的巨大恐慌。它是过去十年科技界最重大的事件，没有之一。
impact.text_en: ChatGPT is the watershed moment in AI history. Before it, AI was a backend algorithm (recommendation systems, face recognition); after it, AI became a frontend productivity tool. It triggered widespread discussion about Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) and brought immense panic regarding AI safety, copyright, and job displacement. It is arguably the most significant event in the tech world in the last decade.

influenced_by.contribution: Transformer架构（ChatGPT中的'T'，没有它就没有大模型）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Transformer Architecture (The 'T' in ChatGPT; without it, there are no Large Models)

influenced_by.contribution: RLHF（AlphaGo证明了强化学习的有效性，OpenAI将类似思想用于调整语言模型，使其听从人类指令）
influenced_by.contribution_en: RLHF (AlphaGo proved the effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning; OpenAI applied similar ideas to align language models with human instructions)

influenced_by.contribution: 算力基础设施（OpenAI依赖数万张NVIDIA A100显卡进行训练和推理）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Compute Infrastructure (OpenAI relies on tens of thousands of NVIDIA A100 GPUs for training and inference)

influenced.contribution: Google Gemini（ChatGPT迫使Google推出了对标产品Bard/Gemini）
influenced.contribution_en: Google Gemini (ChatGPT forced Google to launch its competitor Bard/Gemini)

influenced.contribution: Sora（在文本模型成功后，OpenAI将Transformer+Patch技术应用到视频生成，再次震惊世界）
influenced.contribution_en: Sora (After text success, OpenAI applied Transformer+Patch tech to video generation, shocking the world again)

influence_chain.legacy_text: 它让我们第一次看见了硅基生命的样子。
influence_chain.legacy_text_en: It let us see the face of silicon-based life for the first time.

quiz.question: ChatGPT相比于之前的GPT-3，最关键的技术升级是什么？
quiz.question_en: What was the most critical technical upgrade in ChatGPT compared to the previous GPT-3?
options: 引入了人类反馈强化学习 (RLHF)，使其能理解并遵循人类指令
接入了互联网实时搜索
options_en: Introduced Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to understand and follow human instructions
quiz.explanation: GPT-3虽然知识渊博，但像个野马，经常答非所问。RLHF通过让人类对回答打分，训练模型“对齐”人类的意图，这才是ChatGPT好用的根本原因。
quiz.explanation_en: While GPT-3 was knowledgeable, it was like a wild horse, often giving irrelevant answers. RLHF trained the model to 'align' with human intent by having humans rate its responses, which is the fundamental reason ChatGPT is so usable.
